analysis.summary: The provided annual report document for Narmada Gelatine contains primarily binary encoded or obfuscated text with sparse readable portions including routine headings and metadata strings. No explicit qualitative statements, guidance, demand commentary, capex figures, margin analysis, order details, or risk descriptions could be identified due to the lack of intelligible sentences in the source text. The provided document contains unreadable garbled text, preventing the extraction of any financial or operational information. Consequently, no details regarding guidance, demand outlook, capex, margins, orders, capital allocation, or risks are available. Narmada Gelatines reported revenue from operations of Rs 181.79 crores for FY 2023-24, down 4.89% from Rs 191.14 crores in the prior year.

guidance.claim: India's gelatin market is projected to register a CAGR of 2 to 3% annually over the next few years.
guidance.quote: India's gelatin market is projected to register a CAGR of 2 to 3% every year in the next few years.

guidance.claim: The company expects to improve the quality and yield of gelatine.
guidance.quote: The Company expects to improve the quality and yield of Gelatine.

demand_outlook.claim: Sales volumes for gelatine and DCP dropped by 5% and 8% respectively during the fiscal year.
demand_outlook.quote: Sales volume of gelatine / DCP decreased by 5%/ 8%.

demand_outlook.claim: Average selling price of gelatine increased by 3.28% while DCP prices decreased by 5% compared to the prior year.
demand_outlook.quote: Average selling price of gelatine increased by 3.28% but DCP decreased by 5% as compared to last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Gelatin demand in nutraceutical and pharmaceutical sectors is driven by increasing awareness of collagen's health benefits.
demand_outlook.quote: Gelatin, being a rich source of collagen, is recognised for boosting joint health, skin elasticity, and hair strength, driving its demand in the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for gelatine globally is supported by growing consumption of convenience food and beverages.
demand_outlook.quote: There is also increasing demand for convenience food and beverages due to changing lifestyles, increasing working population as consumers lacks the time to prepare home – cooked food and are more inclined towards convenience food products.

capex_expansion.claim: Discussions are underway to set up a 2 MW solar power plant inside the factory premises.
capex_expansion.quote: Discussion is on for putting up 2 MW solar power plant with in the factory premises.

capex_expansion.claim: No capital investment was made on energy conservation equipment during the year.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital investment on energy conservation equipment : Nil

margins_costs.claim: Material consumed reduced by 1% due to better yield, and power and fuel costs decreased by 1.5% due to improved boiler efficiency and lower coal prices.
margins_costs.quote: Material consumed in fiscal 2023-24 reduced by 1%, which is due to better yield, power and fuel cost reduce by 1.5% due to improvement in boiler's efficiency, which resulted in lower consumption of coal and also due to decrease in the coal prices.

margins_costs.claim: Employee cost increased to 8.21% of revenue from operations compared to 7.17% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Employee cost stood at 8.21% (7.17% previous year) of revenue from operations.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses increased to 6.35% of revenue from operations compared to 6.23% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Other expenses were on the higher side at 6.35% as compared to the previous year at 6.23% of revenue from operations.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sourcing good quality main raw material, crushed bones, presents a significant operational difficulty.
risks_headwinds.quote: The availability of our main raw material, i.e. crushed bones, is a cause of concern The difficulty in sourcing good quality raw material is a major issue.

risks_headwinds.claim: The emergence of plant-based gelatin substitutes acts as a primary barrier to market growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes, fueled by rising demand for vegetarian and vegan goods, is one of the primary market barriers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Low-cost technical grade gelatin imported from China is being illegally blended with Indian gelatin for capsule manufacturing.
risks_headwinds.quote: According to the minutes of the meeting of the Drugs Consultative Committee – there is an increasing evidence that low cost industrial or technical grade gelatin unfit for human consumption is being imported from China, by unscrupulous traders and sold to capsule manufacturers who blend it with high quality gelatin made in India, in the manufacturing of capsules.
